messages.subject: facets on multiple PDF pages
parts:
My faceted plots can get too small if there are a lot on a page. How can
I make them spread across multiple pages (in pdf) if there are more than
N of them?

Thanks,
Jim Rome

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: facets on multiple PDF pages
parts:
Hi James,

You currently need to do that yourself - i.e. figure out how to break
up your data and then use a loop (or otherwise) to output multiple
plots.

Hadley
